tx:
Working on furniture or any construction activity that yields experience in the Construction skill, including building mode, creating flatpacks on a workbench, and Construction Contracts.
A non-click-intensive way to obtain the rocks is to make flatpacks on a portable workbench. A click-intensive and cheap way is to make stone fireplaces as limestone bricks can be acquired for 21 coins each from the Keldagrim Stonemason shop and the Construction Supplies shop in Prifddinas. The shop in Prifddinas has a daily stock of 250 limestone bricks, increasing to 500 when the Voice of Seren is active in the Ithell district. The shop in Prifddinas is also closer to a bank chest.
To conserve resources, it is advised to build something that uses a low number of planks, such as a mahogany armchair.
Using the crystal saw doubles the chance of getting a rock. It works even without using planks (such as with limestone bricks). A crystal saw has enough charges for two full inventories of limestone bricks.
